title: Blue Court Place | KEY.co
meta_description: Experience coastal elegance at its finest
description_expanded: Adjacent to the living area, you'll discover a gourmet kitchen that will delight any aspiring chef. Complete with top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and custom cabinetry adorned with gold accents, this kitchen is both functional and visually stunning. The generous island, accompanied by four stylish barstools, is perfect for meal preparation or casual dining. Additionally, a spacious round dining table for six provides an elegant setting for family meals. Step through the dining area door to find a serene backyard oasis surrounded by bamboo, complete with a private pool, hot tub, and convenient gas grill. Step into this vacation home and be captivated by its exquisite architectural details. The open-concept design welcomes you with graceful archways and soaring vaulted ceilings, creating an atmosphere of elegance and spaciousness. As you pass through the arched openings, you'll enter the main living space, where an abundance of natural light streams through large windows, offering a bright and airy ambiance. Gather your loved ones and unwind together on the ample seating while enjoying a movie night on the mounted 55-inch smart TV.

Features: Please do not use home or villa linens as beach blankets.
